trainers.name: Brock
trainers.strategy: I use the hard-as-rock defense of my Rock-types to outlast any opponent.
trainers.pokemon: I train Rock and Ground-type Pokémon forged by the earth itself.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Brock, the Pewter City Gym Leader. I'm serious about raising Pokémon!

trainers.name: Misty
trainers.strategy: My Water-types will wash away your team before you even see it coming.
trainers.pokemon: I use Water-type Pokémon — beautiful and absolutely deadly.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Misty, the tomboyish mermaid and Cerulean City's Gym Leader!

trainers.name: Giovanni
trainers.strategy: I crush opponents beneath the weight of my Ground-types. There is no escape.
trainers.pokemon: I command Ground-type Pokémon — and the most powerful ones at that.
trainers.selfintro: I am Giovanni. I will show you what it means to face true power.

trainers.name: Lance
trainers.strategy: My Dragons strike before the opponent can even formulate a plan.
trainers.pokemon: I use Dragon-type Pokémon — the mightiest of all.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Lance the Dragon Trainer. Do you still want to take me on?

trainers.name: Prof. Oak
trainers.strategy: Knowledge is my greatest weapon. I use well-rounded Pokémon to cover every angle.
trainers.pokemon: I use a balanced team of fully evolved Pokémon from all three Kanto starters.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Oak — a Pokémon researcher. There's still much we don't know about Pokémon!

trainers.name: Whitney
trainers.strategy: Don't underestimate me! My Miltank will roll right over your whole team.
trainers.pokemon: I use Normal-type Pokémon. Cute but incredibly powerful!
trainers.selfintro: I'm Whitney! Everyone was impressed by my skill and said I should be a Gym Leader!

trainers.name: Morty
trainers.strategy: My Ghost-types phase in and out of reality — you can't hit what you can't see.
trainers.pokemon: I use Ghost-type Pokémon that drift between the world of the living and the dead.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Morty. With my honed skills, I can see what others cannot.

trainers.name: Clair
trainers.strategy: My Dragon-types will obliterate you with sheer force. Resistance is pointless.
trainers.pokemon: I train Dragon-type Pokémon, the most noble and powerful of all.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Clair, the world's best Dragon-type Trainer. That's no brag — just fact.

trainers.name: Norman
trainers.strategy: I build my battles around stamina and balance — Normal-types can outlast anyone.
trainers.pokemon: I use Normal-type Pokémon raised with discipline and heart.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Norman — Petalburg's Gym Leader. And also someone's father, I'm told.

trainers.name: Wally
trainers.strategy: I've grown a lot since we first met. My Pokémon and I won't hold back!
trainers.pokemon: I use Pokémon that grew alongside me — especially my beloved Gallade.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Wally. I used to be frail, but my Pokémon gave me strength to keep going.

trainers.name: Steven Stone
trainers.strategy: I fortify my field with Steel-types, then strike with the power of Rock and Ground.
trainers.pokemon: I use Steel and Rock-type Pokémon — as rare and enduring as the stones I collect.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Steven. I travel the world searching for rare stones... and worthy challengers.

trainers.name: Roxanne
trainers.strategy: I apply everything I've learned at the Trainer's School to methodically wear down opponents.
trainers.pokemon: I use Rock-type Pokémon — solid, reliable, and built to last.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Roxanne. I became a Gym Leader to learn more about Pokémon through battle.

trainers.name: Brawly
trainers.strategy: I ride the wave of battle and strike with Fighting-type combos when the moment is right.
trainers.pokemon: I use Fighting-type Pokémon — trained hard, just like I train in the waves.
trainers.selfintro: Yo, I'm Brawly! I've been buffeted by the rough waves of Dewford, so I'm tough!

trainers.name: Flannery
trainers.strategy: I come out blazing — my Fire-types hit hard and fast before you can cool down.
trainers.pokemon: I use Fire-type Pokémon with burning passion and overwhelming heat.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Flannery! I just took over as Gym Leader and I'm going to battle with everything I've got!

trainers.name: Winona
trainers.strategy: My Flying-types dance through the air and attack from angles you'll never anticipate.
trainers.pokemon: I use Flying-type Pokémon — graceful in the sky, deadly in battle.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Winona. I have soared the skies with my Pokémon and command the sky itself.

trainers.name: Tate
trainers.strategy: Liza and I think as one — our Psychic-types share a bond no opponent can break.
trainers.pokemon: I use Psychic-type Pokémon in perfect sync with my twin sister.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Tate! Together with Liza, our minds and our Pokémon are perfectly united!

trainers.name: Liza
trainers.strategy: Tate and I move in unison — our combined psychic power overwhelms every challenger.
trainers.pokemon: I use Psychic-type Pokémon linked to my twin brother's in perfect harmony.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Liza! Tate and I are twins, and our bond makes us unbeatable together!

trainers.name: Juan
trainers.strategy: My Water-types flow like art — elegant, unpredictable, and impossible to contain.
trainers.pokemon: I use Water-type Pokémon with the grace and beauty of a master coordinator.
trainers.selfintro: I am Juan, artiste extraordinaire and user of Water-type Pokémon. Shall we dance?

trainers.name: Archie
trainers.strategy: I overwhelm with brute force and Water-type power — just like the ocean itself.
trainers.pokemon: I use Water and Dark-type Pokémon as fierce and relentless as the open sea.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Archie, leader of Team Aqua! The sea belongs to all living things — I'll prove it!

trainers.name: Maxie
trainers.strategy: I use calculated, methodical pressure — my Fire and Ground-types leave no room for error.
trainers.pokemon: I use Fire and Ground-type Pokémon to expand the land and fuel our ambitions.
trainers.selfintro: I'm Maxie, the head of Team Magma. Expanding the land will bring prosperity to all humanity.
